# SD13-E5 Ranger level 3 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 3 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-3 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-2 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# Level 3 does not add any new deterministic choice selection: Endurance (the PF1
# Core Rulebook's 3rd-level Ranger class feature this slice grounds) is an automatic
# bonus-feat grant with no player choice involved, and Favored Terrain (the class
# table's other 3rd-level entry) is deliberately left named-but-unproven this slice
# (it would need its own new choice-slot, out of scope). This fixture carries forward
# the same combat-style selections (Archery, Point-Blank Shot) from the level-2
# fixture unchanged, since combat-style's own bonus feat is a one-time 2nd-level
# grant, not re-granted at 3rd level.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level3
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:3
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
